content:
jamie: FYI hit a messed-up rerank result in sampleapp today. Seemed correlated with a retry cascade from the Node helper. Top-k didn't match docs.

jamie: Quick repro (Node helper v0.10.1):
```js
// sendRerank.js
const ids = docs.map(d=>d.id||`doc-${i}`);
const vectors = docs.map(d => padVec(d.embedding, 2048)); // model=sim-2048
await client.rerank.batch({ model: 'sim-2048', body: { ids, vectors } });
```

lee: Can you paste the raw response/logs?

jamie: Server log snippet:
```
[2026-05-12T12:03:12Z] incoming batch id=batch-43 size=8 client=js-0.10.1
[2026-05-12T12:03:12Z] dispatch shard=rerank-a seq=211
[2026-05-12T12:03:13Z] model timeout seq=211
[2026-05-12T12:03:13Z] fallback dispatch shard=rerank-b seq=211 retry=1
[2026-05-12T12:03:14Z] response sent seq=211 idempotency=missing order_preserved=false
```

jamie: Response body (trim):
```
{ scores:[0.92,0.78,0.55,0.51,0.32,0.12,0.07,0.01], ids:["doc-2","doc-0","doc-6","doc-5","doc-1","doc-4","doc-7","doc-3"] }
```

mike: That last line screams: runtime returned explicit ids but SDK mapped by index -> mismatch. Also looks like no x-idempotency-key was set so retry treated as fresh.

lee: I also reproduced an input-shape issue where padVec inserts `null` for missing dims. Runtime coerces null->0 on some shards and errors on others, producing heterogeneous failure modes and more fallbacks. Repro: one doc has embedding length 2030 -> padVec pushed 18 nulls.

ops: Two necessary fixes: (A) SDK: persist per-batch idempotency key across retries; (B) Helper: validate vectors "length==model_dim && every entry is finite number" and map response by returned ids if present.

jamie: Proposed helper change: produce error message like: "bad_vector: id=doc-17 found_len=2030 expected=2048 nulls=18" and a debug flag to dump first 12 values.

mike: I'll open DX issue and a short-lived patch to Node helper that: attach uuid header `x-idempotency-key`, persist it across retry, and switch mapping logic to id-based.

lee: Can we add unit tests in SDK parity suite that stub the runtime to return reordered ids on second call? We need node/python/rust coverage.

ci-bot: Created tasks: DX-4991 (sdk idempotency), DX-4992 (batch mapping tests), DX-4993 (sampleapp quickstart note + CI burst).

jamie: Short-term mitigation: lower default retries to 1 for rerank batch in Node, and add explanatory comment in sampleapp quickstart about idempotency headers.

ops: Long-term: make batch retries idempotent by default and have server honor idempotency header to preserve request->response ordering when re-dispatched. Also add server-side guard: always return explicit ids array for batches.

mike: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/1550 (draft) - includes idempotency header, input validation, and mapping-by-ids. Assigning to @lee for review.

lee: Will review tomorrow. Good catch, Jamie. :thumbsup:
